text: The AI agent harness stores run history and evaluation attempts in SQLite.
FastAPI exposes the agent execution, benchmark, health, and run-history HTTP endpoints.
The agent retries after evaluator feedback, up to a configurable maximum number of attempts.
Ollama provides an optional local language model for planning and answer generation.
Docker Compose runs the FastAPI service and can optionally start an Ollama container.
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests is the standard response when an API rate limit is exceeded.
